definitions.recall_at_5: fraction of a question's source_docs among the documents of the top 5 chunks
definitions.mrr: 1 / rank of the first chunk from a source document, 0 if none in the 20
definitions.hit_at_1: top chunk comes from a source document
definitions.ci95: paired percentile bootstrap over questions, 10000 resamples
definitions.ci95_group: paired bootstrap resampling whole question groups

timing.batch: one call per question, 20 (query, chunk) pairs, max_length 512
